title: AIArchive — model preservation news
description: Captures, mirrors, takedown alerts and radar signals for open-weight AI models

items.title: This week aiarchive.info captured 152 open-weight model repos and mirrored 15 of them for long-term preservation. New captures span major Chinese labs including Qwen (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-Embedding, Qwen-Image), DeepSeek (V3.2, V4-Flash, DeepSeek-OCR), Tencent Hunyuan, MiniMax, Moonshot Kimi, and zai-org GLM, alongside international releases from OpenAI, Meta, Mistral, and Google. Mirrored copies include Baichuan-M3-235B, Yi-6B/34B variants, Seed-OSS-36B, and DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, ensuring these weights remain downloadable independent of their original hosts.
